tei:div.tei:p: (359) 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi gtor bzlog lag len mi pham zhal lung bzhugs// (360)

gtor bzlog gi lag len bshad pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po gnas khang du/ rab rdul tshon/ 'bring dud 'gro'i g.yang gzhi'i steng ras bris kyi bzlog dkyil tshom bu bkod pa/ tha ma ma traṃ gyi dod g.yang gzhis byas pa'i steng du tshom bu 'god pa gsum gyi dang po/ gang du bya ba'i gnas su bdag bskyed rdzogs pa'am/ skad cig gi lha'i rnal 'byor gyis sngags cung zad bzlas/ dkar gtor dang dmar gtor bsngos/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag g.yas sa la bzhag ste/ sku sngags dang*/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces brgyad rtsa brgya bzlas pa kun rdzob kyis sbyang ba dang*/ stong par bsam pa don dam gyis sbyang ba gnyis byas te las sngags bzla bzhin du dug khrag gis chag chag gdab/ thig skud dang tshon sna lnga rang mdog bsdebs pa phyogs bzhi dbus lngar bkod de hūm̐ las byung ba rigs lnga'i gshin rje gshed so sor bskyed la sngags tsam gyis spyan drang bstim pa dang mchod bstod bsdus tsam bya/ de rnams 'od zhu thig (361) tshon rin po che'i rdul phra rab tu bsam la/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrī āḥ zhes brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bzlas te thig skud gcig tu dril ba / dzaḥdzaḥ zhes brjod nas/ sne las kyi rdo rjer gtad la/ thog mar slob dpon nub slob ma shar du gnas pas/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya su tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐ zhes brjod/ thig bskor byas te tshangs thig bzhi'am/ logs thig bcas pa'i ye thig steng gi mkha' la gdab/ las thig dkar chal gyis sbags pa'i srad bus stegs bu'i gzhir tshangs zur thig rnams legs par btab pa'i lte ba nas zlum bskor gyi dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum dang zla gam gsum de'i phyi la lte ba'i brgyad cha/ de nas phyed cha yod pa gsum/ de nas brgyad cha/ bzhi cha/ brgya cha/ phyed cha ste zlum bskor brgyad byas pa'i dang por thod rwa/ gnyis par thod mkhar bzhi/ gsum par rtsibs brgyad/

bzhi par lcags mkhar bcu gnyis/ lnga par mu (362) khyud/ drug par 'obs khung bcu drug bdun par rdo rwa/ brgyad par me ri/ de'i phyir ma traṃ gyi khog pa mgo bo mdun du bstan pa bri/ tshon/ dbus kyi gru gsum mthing nag zla gam gsum khrag mtsho/ thod rwa rnams dkar po/ thod mkhar nang khyams dmar po'am ljang gu/ 'khor lo sngon po mchan ljang*/ lcags mkhar gru gsum sngo nag gzhi dmar/ mu khyud ljang*/ 'obs khung gi gzhi nag po gru gsum dmar nag gam/ yang na gzhi dmar gru gsum mthing nag tu bya/ rdo rwa gzhi nag po rdo rje ser po/ me ri kha dog sna tshogs/ ma traṃ sngo skya khro nyams can no/ lcags mkhar bcu gnyis ni phyogs bzhir gnyis re mtshams bzhir re re ste gru gsum pa'i rtse mo nang bstan du bya/ 'obs khung bcu drug gi phyogs mtshams brgyad dang phyogs bzhi'i g.yas g.yon du re re ste gru gsum rtse mo phyir bstan du bri/ de ltar legs par bris nas bra bo khrag gis sbags pas tshom bu gzhung gi lha grangs ltar 'god par bya'o/ rgyas par spro na mu khyud kyi phyir rta babs brgyad pa can gyi gzhal yas sgo rdzogs bri la/ de ltar na 'obs khung ni padma'i phyi rol dur khrod kyi nang du bri/ 'di ni las gzhung ltar lcags 'dra lugs so/ gal lte bzlog gzhung ltar lcags sdig lugs su byed na dbus gling dgur bcad pa'i dbus (363) gru gsum mthing nag la gtso bo yab yum/ phyogs brgyad du shar du phyag na rdo rje sogs dang*/ mtshams bzhir rgyan lha yab yum zung re/ gling dgu'i phyi rol gru gsum byas la thod rwas bskor ba'i zla gam gsum la sprul pa gsum/ de'i phyir 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi phyogs bzhir gsang gshed bzhi/ g.yas bzhir nang gshed bzhi/ g.yon bzhir phyi gshed bzhi/ de'i phyi rol gyi zur bzhir gru gsum rtse nang bstan sum brtsegs re rer 'chi bdag bcu gnyis/

de'i phyi khyams su zur gsum rtse nang bstan phyogs rer brgyad kyi shar du bdud pho brgyad/ lhor gshin rje brgyad/ nub tu ma mo brgyad/ byang du gnod sbyin brgyad do/ sgo rdzogs spro na gong 'dra/ min na 'obs khung sogs gong 'dra'o/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su drag po'i shing khri gru gsum rkang pa gsum pa mi mgo'i tog can srid pa lugs 'byung gi gtor stegs sam/ lcags kyi mañdzi'i khar lcags slang bug rdol med par bzlog gtor khro zhal can/ 'khor rtsa lha drug gi grangs kyi bskor ba'am/ ri rab mar lha grangs kyi gtor mas bskor ba'am/ 'jam dpal gshes gnyen gyi gzigs snang gtor ma thog dbal can du byas pa gsum gang rung bshams la/ mtshe yungs gtor gdugs lha tsaka rtsang dang rgyu mas bskor ba rngams brjid (364) ldan par bya/ bzlog pa'i 'phrul 'khor gang rung bris yod na gtor mar gzhug gtor chen gyi 'og tu mañdzis btegs pa'i zor kong gcig dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' rdo rwa'i steng gi phyogs mtshams kun tu zor kong sbyin bdag gi lo grangs sam/ ma 'grub na nyer gcig sogs ji rigs bsham/ de yang dur khrod dang ri sul 'dre can g.yul bkye phung shul sogs drag po'i sa sna/ bra bo nas nag gi phye bsres par dug khrag gis chus sbrus pa las grub pa'i kong bu gru gsum sor bzhi pa kha ris dmar po gzhung nag po logs gsum la bhyo zlog rbad gsum khrag gis bris pa'i nang rdzas blugs/ de steng dbus su khrag kong gru gsum steng khrag gtor gru gsum khrag gis sbags pa dang*/ kong bu'i nang du zor rdzas/ spos ring*/ rgya spos/ brag spos/ gu gul/ rabs chad kyi khang pa'i dud pa ral pa can/ phab rtsi/ chang nyes sbang ma/ ram gyi phyi mo/ lcags zangs rdo phyer dug khrag gis chus byugs pa/ rta dmar tshil/ tsher ma/ sha khrag rus pa sna tshogs/ btsan dug sogs dug sna tshogs/ me tog sna tshogs/

me tog nag po/ yungs nag rwa gzhob/ yugs sa'i 'phang gi rtsang byas pa'am phye ma rnams blug kong bu gru gsum rer dug sna'i dug zor dang*/ khrag sna'i khrag zor dang*/ gtor zor chung ngu rnams kyang (365) 'jog kha khyer la g.yas mda' bkra/ g.yon du 'phang bkra/ rgyab tu rtsang*/ logs gsum la g.yas su yungs dkar gang bu'am/ khram shing la mar bskus te yungs dkar sbyar ba/ g.yon du brag nag gi mtshe/ mdun du dpal 'bar gzuug tshon skud sna lnga dang bal tshon sna lngas de rnams kyi sked par dkris pa'o/ dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas su dur khrod kyi rdo nag gam/ mi bsad rbab rdo bya sgong tsam lnga la khrag gis bhyo zlog rbad bris pa/ g.yon du tshon sna lnga'i 'ur rdo la mi lpags kyi mthil dang yugs sa'i skra yi ljags can bcas/ skyer pa'i mda' la 'ug pa srin bya khra gsum gyi sgro spras pa/ gri lcags kyi mde'u rtser khrag gis byugs pa/ logs la sngags bzlog gsham bcas khrag gis bris pa lnga dal gyi g.yas dang*/ zor gzhu g.yon/ dal gyi mdun du rwa zor ni rab mi rta khyi gsum bsad pa'am/ 'bring gang rung bsad pa/ tha ma gang rnyed kyis g.yag rgod kyi rwa g.yas pa'i rgyab sgang 'bur gyi phyogs su khro bo'i mig dang*/ rtser me ri/ rtsa bar sbrul gyis 'khyud pa bris pa khri'u lta bu'i khar gzhag de'i zur du thod tshal nang thun khrag gu gul sogs rwa zor byin rlabs kyi rdzas dang*/ gzhan zor kong zhig la yungs dkar gyi gong bu (366) btsugs pa g.yas dang*/ khrag thun blugs pa g.yon du gshom kyang gsungs/ mtha' bskor du/ byang shar mtshams 'dzin me tog nas brtsams drag mchod g.yas bskor/ de'i phyi la shar du mchod gtor dpal gtor dmar po lto bar khram ris can 'khor rang 'dra lnga dang*/ de 'phros lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i mtheb skyu can/ lhor bshags gtor dkar po zlum po 'khor bzhi pa/ nub tu skong gtor dpal gtor dmar po 'khor bzhi pa/

byang du zlog gtor gru gsum 'khor bzhi pa rnams kyang dgod/ yang na skong bshags gnyis ka dpal gtor dmar po lha grangs mnyam pa'i mtheb skyu can du bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du bam skong rkang pa bsnol nas tsog pur 'dug cing lag pa bsnol bas thod pa gnyis su sman raka 'khyer ba/ spyi bor bshos bu gru gsum rtser bya nag bcas pa dang*/ mar thag dkar dmar gyis rke nas zhabs su dkris pa'i pus mo'i bar du tshil chen gyi mar me/ g.yas g.yon rgyab tu g.yag ra lug gzugs brnyan rnams sgrub rten bya dus mi dgos kyang 'dir dgos/ de mañdzi'i steng du bzhag pa'i 'og tu thod nang rabs chad dang rta g.yag nag po'i snying ngam/ tshal bu bsres pa'i snying gzugs gsum dar nag gis bkab pa/ mchod bstod gsal sgron gyi gtor ma rtsa ba zan leb gru bzhi rtse (367) mo gru gsum gyi logs gsum la mtheb skyu sbyar ba sha khrag gis brgyan pa bsham/ gzhan yang nub re bzhin gtong rgyu'i bzlog pa'i thun gtor zur gsum 'khor drug pa khrag yungs kyis brgyan pa dang*/ bzlog pa sogs phrin las bcol dus 'bul rgyu'i gtor chung grangs mang*/ khrag skyems dang gser skyems/ nyin bzhin 'bul rgyu'i tshogs dang bsgral las kyi rten nya bo/ chos skyong gi 'bul gtor chad brtan sogs ji ltar 'os pa rnams kyang bsham/ phyogs gang bder bsgral chas rnams kyang gzhag dkyil 'khor gyi rgyab phyogs su mtho bar byas pa'i bang rim gnyis kyi dang por tshe bdag gi sgrub gtor gzigs snang ma ni/ gdan chos 'byung gru gsum gnyis bsnol tha gru mnyam la srid du 'og ma che tsam byas pa'i 'og ma'i dkyil brus par ling ga bzhag chos 'byung 'og ma'i rtse gsum du thod skam gsum bzhag pas chos 'byung steng ma dang mnyam pa'i steng bshos bu gru gsum logs la gri ris can/ mdun gyi gri ris dbus phyir 'bur thabs byas pa de'i zur gsum thod skam steng du 'grigs par dgod/

steng gi chos 'byung gi rtse mo phyir thon pa de dang tha gru mnyam pa'i gru gsum rtse phyir bstan dang*/ de gnyis kyi bar du gru gsum rtse nang bstan te bzhag pas (368) lcags mkhar la phyogs rer zur gsum re ste bcu gnyis/ bshos bu zur gsum drug chos 'byung gi rtsibs kyi bar drug tu gzhag rtse mor nor bu 'bar bas rgyan no/ mtheb skyu grangs mang sha khrag gis brgyan pa me ri'i rgyan spros can gyis chog de'i g.yas g.yon du rtsa gsum gzhan 'don na de'i gtor ma/ bang rim 'og mar tshe bdag gi mchod gtor/ g.yas g.yon chos skyong pho rgyud mo rgyud gang byed/ g.yas su rgya gram dkar po'i steng*/ lha klu gnyis la dkar zlum re/ klu la sbrul dkris klu sman btab pa/ dkar mngar gyis brgyan cing rtsa bar zan leb kyis phyogs gcig dkris pa/ g.yon du rgya gram dmar po'i steng*/ btsan bshos dmar po gru gsum/ bdud bshos gru bzhi rtsi rgyal can gnyis sha khrag gis brgyan pa rtsa ba zung zan leb gcig gis dkris pa ste gter srung mthu chen sde bzhi'o/ de'i g.yas g.yon du rgyun bzhag gi chad brtan dang*/ sman raka bcas bshams pa'i mdun du nyer spyod kyi mchod pa bshams/ stabs mi bde na sgrub mchod kyi gtor ma bang rim gcig la bkod kyang rung ngo/ dngos gzhi la 'jam dpal zhi ba'i rgyud bklag chog dbang po'i sdes mdzad pa de sngon du btang nas/ bdag mdun cho ga gcig gis mnyam du bskyed pa dang*/ zor rdzas rnams mtshon cha'i (369) char 'phro zhing zor bdag gi tshogs grangs med 'phro bas bzlog pa'i las mdzad pa sogs/ ting 'dzin gyi rol pa sna tshogs 'jug shes par bya la/ bzlas pa'i skabs don gnyis sgrub pa'i 'phro 'dus dmigs pa spyi ltar la/ a kro= sku gsung thugs sngags e ring rnams brgya re'am/ skabs sbyar bzlas te stong tshig gi mchod bstod/ de nas/ bdag mdun dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi sku'i cha thams cad nas 'od zair gnam lcags kyi so dang spu gri'i dbal can gyi mtshon cha sna tshogs pa'i rang bzhin du 'phros pas gnod byed thams cad myal myal gcod par gyur/

e ring gzir spyang can brgya tsam bzla/ yang lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las rdo rje'i me 'od gnam lcags zhun ma'i tshwa tshwa ltar 'phros pas gnod byed thams cad choms choms thul gyis bsregs par bsam la/ e ring bzlog spyang can brgya tsam bzla/ mthar thal mo gsum brdab/ gzhung bstod dang dbyangs gsal rten snying bzlas la/ mchod bstod gsal sgron tshang bar btang ba'i/ bya khyung rgyal pos gang yin lus srog phrol/ zhes pa'i mtshams su rwa zor byin rlabs bya ste/ de yang mi rta khyi gsum bsad myong gi rwa yin na ngar 'don mi dgos/ de min na ngar 'don pa'i rten 'brel du zan gtsang (370) mar mi rta khyi gsum gyi gzugs brnyan bcos pa lcags slang nang du bsham/ rakta bran e ring tshar gcig gis brub khung dang gzugs brnyan dgra bgegs su bskyed la sprul pa spro/ dgug gzhug bya/ gru gsum e yi snod nang du= sogs kyis bsgral ba bya zhing slob dpon gyis rwa zor de dag gi snying gar bsnun nas sgrol ba'i stangs ka tsam bya/ mi gsod myong ba zhig la gtad nas des rwa zor gyi rtse mos gzugs brnyan gsum po dum bur gtub/ ling ro sman phud kyis bran te gtor ma la 'bul zhing*/ e phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor bcas la sogs kyis zhal bstab bya'o/ rwa zor byin rlabs dngos ni/ rwa zor de slob dpon gyis lag g.yas su thogs pa gu gul gyis bdug ste/ e bhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ thun snod gru gsum e yis dbyings nam mkha' las kyi btson khang du gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam la/ nang dang rtser dug khrag gis byugs shing*/ ra rakta dzwa la mā ra ya phaṭaḥ bi ṣa ha la hūm̐/ zhes ci rigs brjod pas/ mon pa pho mo rnams kyis dug mtshon gyi char dbab par bsam/ khrag gis rlan par yungs dkar nag dang lcags phye zangs phye'i skam thun brab/ sku dang gsung gi sngags mthar/ nṛ tri gnod byed dgra bgegs kyi srog la thun rmugs bhyo:

byad ma gnod byed kyi srog la thum ri li li (371)bhyo: zhes lan mang brjod la phus gdab/ rwa zor gshin rje las kyi btson khang e yi snod nam mkha' dang mnyam pa me ri khrag mtsho thog ser 'khrugs pa'i klong na las kyi gshin rje'i tshogs sprul pa'i pho nya snang srid kyi dregs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzod par dka' ba'i tshul du khro zhing rngams pas dgra bgegs rdul du rlog pa'i las byed par bsam/ kha phung res bcad tshon skud lngas bcings la sngar gyi sar dgod/ mchod bstod gsal sgron 'phros gtang*/ mchod bstod gsal sgron 'di bsad bskul bzlog bskul gang yang rung*/ de nas gsol ka dang*/ tshogs phud mchod bshags bsgral gsum/ gnam phud/ lhag ma bcas spros nas tshogs bar bshags yan btang*/ bskul dang skyems gzu/ e khang skyed pa nas/ phung po gtub pa'i bar bsgral las rgyas par byas la zhal bstab/ de rjes bam bskang dang*/ rtsa gsum spyi skong*/ tshogs la rol cing lhag ma btang ba'am/ byang shar du brtson du 'dzin/ yang na lhag chog thun gtor rjes su bya'o/ de nas bzlog gzhung mgor/

bdag dang mdun gyi zor rdzas rnams drag po'i dkyil 'khor las sprul pa'i zor bdag dregs pa ye shes dang las dang 'jig rten gyis bsdus pa ma tshang ba med pa (372)thams cad dgra bgegs byad ma'i steng du khros 'khrugs rngams par gyur pa'i tshogs las khro chu dug mtshon gyi sprin drag sngags kyi 'brug stong ldir zhing nad mtshon sogs gdug pa'i thog char drag tu 'bebs pa phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod bsrung bya 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dang khyad par du dgra bgegs byad ma rnams kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad sbur ma rlung gis ded pa bzhin bsdus te/ gnod byed de dag gi steng du phab pas dpung 'khor sde ris dang bcas pa nag thul gyis rjes med du brlag par bsam la/ thun sngags dang bcas/ sku gsung thugs sngags e ring bcas gsham 'dogs/ 'char ka rdo rje pha lam/ me spur bcas kyi sngags rnams nyer gcig mthar thal mo brdab/ na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud= sogs dang*/ khyad par du 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed phyag rgya zil gnon gyi lha tshogs bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa ste/ bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod bsrung bya mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa'i sngon las 'phral rkyen ngan pa/ 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par (373)du pha rol mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bsam ngan sbyor rtsub rbad 'dre rbod gtong chag che nyam nga ltas ngan bar chad mi mthun pa'i 'tshe ba gang dang ci mchis pa thams cad dgra bgegs byad ma kho rang gi steng du zlogs shig sgyur cig mā ra ya rbad zlog lan gsum brjod la thal mo brdab/ bzlog gzhung tshar gcig tsam bskyar/ mthar thun gtor la rakta bran/ dgug gzhug bya/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ gtor snod dmar gyi dung chen yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor rdzas dgra bgegs bsgral ba las byung ba'i sha yi ri bo/

khrag gi rgya mtsho/ rus pa'i phung po klad zhag gi lbu phreng 'khrigs pa/ dam tshig tu 'os pa'i 'dod yon gyi rnam pa ma tshang ba med pas nam mkha' dang mnyam par gang ba/ ngo bo zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ sman phud bran la a kro sogs spyi bsnyen la gtor sngags btags pas 'bul/ hūm̐/ dmar chen gtor zor gshin rje'i tshogs// sde brgyad dregs pa'i dpung dang bcas/ dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du rbad/(374)/srid pa g.yo zhing 'khrugs byed ba'i// dmag dpung der skyed g.yul ngo sprod// dgra dpung choms la bgegs dpung thul// rjes shul lhag ma med par mdzod// dus la bab po mthu rtsal skyed/ /ces pas zor du 'phang ba'am 'bul chog gzhan sbyar yang rung*/ de nas gsol kha mchod/ chad tho'i gtor mar sman raka bran la 'bul/ brtan gtor la sman bran nam mkha' mthong sar btegs la 'bul/ de dag gi snod sbubs te bro brdung*/ mchod bstod bzod gsol bsdu ldang bkra shis par bya'o/ sang zor 'phen ba'i do nub sgo dbye bya na/ bzlas pa'i mjug e ring bzlog spyang can bzla skabs mchod g.yog gi phyogs gtor bzhi nas blangs te g.yas gral gyi mtha' logs nas rim bzhin lag 'grim la thams cad kyis 'phen pa'i stangs ka gar pad lta bur bsgyur zhing thal mo brdab/ zor rdzas la phus 'debs/ de bzhin zor skong thams cad dang*/ rdo zor 'ur rdog bcas dang*/ mda' gzhu/ rwa zor byin rlabs/ rdzas khrag yungs/ bzlog gtor gyis mtha' brten pa g.yas skor du bskor la slar dkyil 'khor la bsgrig zor skong rnams 'di nas bzung phyir bstan du bsgrig dgong mo bzlog (375) gzhung grub rjes 'jam chas kyis sgrub khang steng ngam sgor zor lam dang bstun/ gser skyems mthar slob dpon gyis cung zad gsol/

de'i lhag ma gtor ma dang lhag mar bran/ srid pa ho'i rgyab yig bklag lhag ma gtang*/ gtor ma'i lam ston dus phyogs gtor 'phen/ phud gtor/ steng gi lha la gser skyems mchod= mthar zor kong rdo zor mda' zor gsum re re 'phen/ rwa zor gdengs tsam bya/ bhyo bhyo/ bzlog gtor zur pa 'phang*/ thal mo brdab/ bstan ma dang mtshams gcod byas nas nang du log las rjes bsdu/ phyir nyin bam skong mi btang*/ da ni bzlog pa'i dus la bab/ zhes pa'i dus zor zhal zor lam du bsgyur/ dkar lam 'then/ dmar gyi gtor ma'i mchod pa= skabs mchod bshags skong zlog gi gtor ma bzhi zor chen rtsar 'bul/ zor rdzas gzhan rnams spags/ byad ma 'bum gyi ltas ngan zlog rjes su zor chen btegs/ ser sbreng gi rjes slob dpon drag chas rwa zor thogs la lam 'gros kyis phebs/ zor chen shul du bam bkod/ gom pa bdun cu tsam 'das pa'i sar gtor tshugs steng zor rnams bzhag la/ gser skyems/ srid ho'i (376) dkar gtor/ lhag ma 'don yang der mi mchod par sna la khyer zhing gang du phen pa'i gdong la gtang*/ zor 'cham bya/ zor rnams 'phen tsam bya/ phus btab/ sngar ltar byon/ 'phen par/ dmigs bya dgug bstim dang*/ 'phang tshig sngar ltar gyis 'phang*/ zor chen btegs la me sbar/ bhyo bhyo sdang ba'i= zor 'phang*/ phod ka'i sna gnyis bzung ba'i dul mo dgu brdab/ thal mo dgu brdab/ bshal chus brtan ma bskyang*/ mtshams gcod dang srung 'khor bsgom/ e ring la gsang lam dgag pa'i spyang mo dang*/ uṣṇi ṣa 'a ི sngags bzlas/ slar log sgo drung du gtor gzhong sbubs la dgug gzhug dang*/ lag g.yon steng mar bsnol ba'i mthe'u chung sbrel nas bro ra zlum por bskor la bro rdung 'don/ tshig bstun rkang pa gdengs tsam bya/ e ring mnan spyang can dang*/ sumbha ni= bro gral g.yas bskor gyis slob dpon shar nas zhi ba'i gsol byang*/ g.yon bskor byang drag po/

g.yas bskor nub dbang*/ g.yon bskor lho rgyas pa/ gtor gzhong gyen du bstan la 'bru 'thor/ nang du log nas gtor ma thog khar 'bul zhing chad tho sogs las rjes bsdu/ spro na/ sang nyin las gzhung bsrang*/ bam bskang du bam gyi me/ sbar/ (377) rtsa gsum bskang ba'i rjes gtor ma bsgul/ sman raka bran/ slob dpon gyis nas 'thor lag gi reg tsam byas la/ thog khar sbreng tshar bsham/ sgrub khang steng du byon ste/ sngags drug phyag drug dang*/ gser skyems gtang*/ chad tho 'don la/ zhal nang bstan du phul/ badzra muḥ sa gtor mgron gshegs/ nang du log la mchod bstod sogs rgyas par bya'o/ 'di dag byang pa'i phyag bzhes so/ rnying ma spyi 'gros byed na/ nyin tha ma bzlog gzhung grub nas/ dkyil 'khor lha la mchod bstod dang yig brgya tshar gcig hūm̐ ha he phaṭaḥbhyo raṃ/ gtor ma'i ye shes pa nam mkhar btegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bstim/ slar yang gtor chen zor rdzas dang bcas pa dpal phyag rgya zil gnon lha tshogs sprul pa yang sprul pho nya zor bdag dregs pa'i dmag tshogs thams cad khros 'khrugs rngam pa'i rang bzhin gyis stong gsum skad cig la brlag nus pa'i mthu rtsal chen pos dgra bgegs byad ma'i steng du rngams zhing rgyug par gyur/ rbad thuṃ/ ri li li/ e ring bzlog spyang can mthar/ dril shag srog khyer bhyoḥ tri myags ka sa ya: rtogs med srog len nag po'i sngags bsdebs sbyar te (378) bzlas la zor skong sngar ltar bya/ thun gtor la dgug gzhug dang byin rlabs sngags 'bul bcas dang*/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan gshin rje gshed po 'khor bcas la// dgra bgegs sha khrag rus pa nang khrol tshogs// lhun po spungs pa'i 'dod dgu'i ba ling ta// phyi nang nyer spyod sman raka bdud rtsi'i tshogs// 'bul lo dgyes par rol la bdag cag gi nad gdon kun zhi tshe dpal longs spyod spel/ khams gsum dbang bsdus dgra bgegs bdud sde'i dpung*// thams cad ming gi lhag mar tshar chod cig

/phas rgol bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byad stems rnams// thams rang gshed phob la mthu nus shig /mdor na bdag gi re 'bras gang yin pa// 'bad med lhun gyi grub pa'i phrin las mdzod/ ces dmag lto'i tshul du zor rtsar phul/ de rjes gser skyems dang*/ gzhung gi gtor ma'i lam bstan sogs nas/ bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ zhes pa'i bar 'don/ phyi rol du gser skyems mchod/ sgo dbye/ de nas chad tho bton cing gtor ma zor rtsar 'bul/ de rjes zor rnams khyer la gtor tshugs sam za lam du/ gser skyems dang srid ho'i rgyab yig bklag (379) lhag ma btang*/ der mi mchod/ zor 'phen sar/ gser skyems/ gzu dpang dang*/ dgug gzhug rjes/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang gi /drag po e yi gzhal yas nas// phyag rgya zil gnon lha tshogs kyi// thugs dam chen po'i dus la babs// drag po zor gyi las mdzod cig ces bskul nas/ hūm̐/ steng gi lha la= sogs kyi mthar/ e ring bzlog spyang btags pa'i sngags bzla bzhin rol mo dang bcas/ hūm̐/ khrag 'thung 'jam dpal gshin rje yi// pho nyar sngags pa zor gyi bdag /dgra bgegs sgrol phyir las la ya// gru gsum gdug pa kong bu'i zor// glog ltar 'khyug cing thog ltar 'bebs// dgra bgegs lus sems 'ben la ya/ e ring mthar bzlog spyang sbrel nas 'phang*/ de bzhin du zor kong tshab tu/ ri bo nyil ba rdo yi zor/ ༈ gnam lcags shugs ldan gtor ma'i zor/ ༈ rba klong 'khrugs pa khrag gi zor/ ༈ mun pa thib pa dug gi zor/ ༈ rno myur shugs drag mda' yi zor/ ༈ stobs ldan shugs drag rwa yi zor/ so sor kha bsgyur la 'phang*/ (380)hūm̐/ dmar chen gtor zor= sogs kyis zor chen 'phangs nas/ zlog pa/ bhyo bhyo sdang ba'i dgra la= spro na dgongs gsol dmod pa can bya/ 'phen dus kyi dmigs pa ni/ gtor snod drag po'i gzhal yas su zor rdzas las kyi pho nya dregs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnam lcags thog char ltar 'khrugs pas dgra bgegs rtsa sbur mes bsreg pa ltar rjes shul med par bcom pa dang zor kong rnams ri bo mchog rab dang mnyam pa'i khro chu'i ri rab gru gsum pa pho nya dang nad mtshon dug gi rba rlabs 'khrigs pa/

rdo zor ri rab kyi tshad dang mnyam pa'i rdo zor thogs pa'i gnod sbyin gdug pa'i bu mo/ zor gzhu'i ya mchog la 'brug sgra ldir zhing ma mchog la glog dmar 'khyug pa'i chang gzung nas thog mda' ser ltar 'phro ba/ rwa zor e yi btson khang nas las gshin gyi dmag tshogs sprin ltar 'khrigs shing drag sngags kyi 'brug stong ldir ba/ nad dang dug khrag gi na bun 'thib pa/ mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char dang thog ser drag po 'phro ba/ gtor zor gyi rtse mor mtshon cha sna tshogs skar ltar 'khrugs pa/ sked par zor bdag pho mo bu yug ltar 'tshub pa rtsa bar khrag mtsho 'khyil zhing phyogs kun tu (381)me ri dmar nag 'bar ba/ zor rdzas thams cad las kyang pho nya dang mtshon cha sna tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa lcags zhun gyi zil ltar khol zhing snang srid kyi gdug pa ma lus pa 'dus pa'i ngo bo dgra bgegs gdug pa can 'dul ba la thogs pa med pa'i mthu dang ldan par bsam/ khrag zor khrag gi rgya mtsho nad sna tshogs kyi rlangs pa sngo dmar 'phyur ba la nad bdag ma mo'i tshogs skar ltar 'phro ba/ dug zor dug gi rang bzhin dug rlangs mun pa ltar 'thib pa la zor bdag dmu dang bdud la sogs pa 'phro ba/ zor 'phangs bas gnod byed kho rang gi lha srung rnams kho rang gi bdud du babs te zan la khyi rub pa bzhin kho rang gi sha khrag dmar chil gyis btang de hab sha byed cing zos par bsam la/ e ring gsang lam dgag pa'i spyang mo can cung zad dang*/ las byang gi srung 'khor 'don dmigs bya/ slar log nas sgo drung du gtor snod sbubs steng brtan gtor bshams la btang*/ dgra bgegs dgug gzhug bcas/ gnod byed rnams kyi mgo dang lce steng gser 'khor rtsibs brgyad kyi lte bar gnam lcags kyi phur bus thal phyung du phug ste phur pa'i rgya mdud ri rab (392)tu gyur pas mnan nas g.yo 'gul med par bsam la/ e ring mnan spyang can cung zad bzla/

mthar/ de steng 'byung bzhi rim brtsegs dang gtor gzhong ri rab tu gyur pas mnan pa'i steng du lha yi pho brang bcas pas nam yang ldang du med par bsam la/ bro brdung 'don/ gtor gzhong kha gyen du bstan par nas 'thor bkra shis brjod/ nang du log nas/ mdun du bam gyi lus la tshe bdag gi lha tshogs gsal zhing bdag mdun gyi 'od zer lcags kyus 'khor 'das kyi tshe bcud yon tan thams cad bsdus te bdag mdun la thim par bsam/ spyi bsnyen la/ ā yurdzñā na nṛ bhrūm̐ dzaḥ btags pa bzla/ tshe 'gugs ni/ hūm̐/ tshe la dbang mdzad gshin rje'i gshed// phyag mtshan be con 'khor lo yis// gshin rje'i gnas khang bcom nas ni// gshin rje'i lag nas tshe phrogs la// rnal 'byor bdag la tshe stsol cig a kro bcu bdun ma'i mthar/ ā yuḥdzñā na g.yu tshe a ba na ya bhrūm̐ḥ tshe bhrūm̐ g.yu bhrūm̐ āḥyurdzñā na bhrūm̐ḥ zhes lan gsum mam bdun brjod la bam las dngos grub blang*/ de nas chos skyong gi gtor ma mchod pa sogs cho ga'i las rjes spyi ltar bsdu/ rdul tshon (383) yin na gshegs gsol bton rjes/ ā ka ro brjod de slob dpon gyis rdo rjes byang shar nas brtsams dbus su bsdu/ ras bris yin na tshom bu 'jig lhar ldang nas dge bsngo shis brjod bya'o/ de ltar ji skad bshad pa'i rdzas sngags dmigs pa cho ga'i phyag len ma nyams par byas pa'i gtor bzlog brtsams na ji lta bu'i rkyen ngan yang 'phral la bzlog nges te mi bzlog pa gang yang med par gsungs so// zhes pa'ang 'jam dpal mi yi gzugs su snang ba mi pham rgya mtsho'i gtor bzlog lag len tshig sna bstung*/ zhal 'phang dkyus su bsabs nas bris pa dge legs 'phel// dge'o//
